title: Projection Object v1
description: The committed, deterministic per-UID projection document at `.atdd/state/projection/<uid>.yaml`. Authoritative for shared project state (doc section 2.1). Identity is the immutable uid, never the slug; the filename is derived from the uid. Deletion is a tombstone, never file removal (section 10).

body.description: Core-authored; conflict unless the single-owner rule proves safe.

extension_digests.description: Core writes; provider supplies. Derived from lock/provider digest.

external_refs.description: Extension-bot writable ONLY. Non-authoritative: lifecycle code MUST NOT read this (I7, section 8.2 rule 5).

last_lifecycle_actor.description: Last actor to write a lifecycle field (phase/state). Lets the field-writer validator and the merge driver explain a conflict.

owner_actor.description: The single actor that owns `body`. Section 7.1: body conflicts unless the single-owner rule proves safe. Without this the rule is not computable.

phase.description: Monotonic and gate-validated (section 7.1). COMPLETE is NOT storable: it is DERIVED from merge-to-main (section 18 decision 1). A committed projection carrying phase=COMPLETE is invalid.

slug.description: Mutable display metadata; must not drive identity or file location.

state.description: TOMBSTONED is a retirement record that prevents resurrection (section 7.1).

train.description: Core train ops; conflict unless same digest.

uid.description: Immutable, globally unique, never reused (section 10 rule 1).

operations.description: Core reads and validates the projection_object projection artifact; consumers treat it as read-only.

200.description: A projection_object conforming to this schema.
